newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ArQule an outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ArQule an outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst Matthew Murray said in a research note he initiated coverage of ArQule Inc with an outperform recommendation and a 12-month price target of $29 per share.
-- "...ArQule is a leading player in the use of combinatorial chemistry to optimize lead compounds for drug development.

-- "Currently, the company has 52 lead optimization programs. To date four pharmaceutical companies have entered into drug discovery collaborations with the company. We anticipate two additional deals in first quarter 1997, including one deal with a agricultural company," according to the analyst's note.

-- "The company is in sound financial condition with $37 million is cash from its recent IPO. We believe that the company will be profitable in 1997. In addition to its pharmaceutical collaborations, the company has also formed drug discovery joint ventures (from which it retains 50 percent of any future financial upside) with seven leading biotech companies," according to Murray.
-- Shares rose 1-3/4 to 17-1/4, a new high, in early Nasdaq trade.
-- The company went public last October with a 2.5 million share offering at $12 per share.
